description: Euro Panel Products Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of aluminum composite panels (ACP) in India and Europe. The company provides ACP, HPL, core composite, and honeycomb panels; fire retardant, zinc composite, solid aluminum, and engineered solid panels; and ACP louvers and fins. It offers its products under the Eurobond brand through a network of dealers and distributors. The company also exports its products. It serves pharma/hospitals, automobile, corporate signage, transport, metro and railways, petroleum, government, construction, and banking sectors. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
